verdict.rationale: Kong AI Gateway/Konnect is a SaaS-hosted control plane with configuration, logs, and analytics data, so data portability/export-and-leave is a fair axis to ask, but the evidence pack contains no mention of a bulk data export feature, open-format export of configs/logs/analytics, or a documented migration-out path in open standards. Evidence only covers observability (metrics, logs) and a CLI conversion extension for migrating configs between versions, not exporting all user data to leave the platform.
